findings.title: Alias gate's len==0 skip: 15/57 pins vacuous in-fixture + empty-but-allocated aliases uncaught (the exact crash class)
findings.evidence: if len(a) == 0 { return } — fixture sets neither health_enabled nor advance_gate_enabled and runs no lane cmds, so health (9) + era_gate (5) + pipe_lane_over (1) pins always skip
findings.detail: The skip is load-bearing (two correctly-cloned empty arrays both nil -> false fail) but the guarded class can present len-0-allocated; a future missed field in a fixture-unexercised subsystem ships unguarded.
findings.recommended_fix: Grow the fixture: enable health + advance gate (or assert non-empty for pinned arrays so a vacuous pin fails loudly).

findings.title: Run_State deep-copy mirror lives in the view layer; core owns the lifetime pair but not the clone
findings.evidence: shadow_clone :: proc(src: ^pp.Run_State, allocator := context.allocator) -> pp.Run_State { clone := src^ ... } — hand-maintained in app/render
findings.detail: Structural root of this bug class: every core field addition needs a hand-edit in the view layer; #107 added box fields and the mirror missed them. Now test-guarded, still manual.
findings.recommended_fix: Move shadow_clone (or a field-inventory invariant) into core next to run_init/run_destroy.

findings.title: The alias gate is a manually-synced checklist, not an automatic invariant
findings.evidence: // One line per array run_destroy frees — a NEW Run_State dynamic array must add (a) its clone line in shadow_clone AND (b) its pin line here.
findings.detail: Comment-enforced discipline: a new array added without (a)+(b) passes CI silently unless a fixture grows it. Same debt as the mirror itself.
findings.recommended_fix: Reflection-based field walk (Odin type_info) to enumerate [dynamic] fields, or a build-time check.

findings.title: Test comments overstate pre-fix behavior: the economy leg fails the w1 alias pin, it does not abort

findings.title: Economy-leg window math wraps u64 if terminal_spawn_interval_ticks drops to <= 5 (suite hang)
findings.evidence: base := interval * w; lead := base - 5 — u64 wrap at interval <= 5
findings.detail: Latent: shipped catalog pins 80; reachable only via a catalog edit. A wrap makes for tick in t_prev+1..=lead effectively unbounded.
findings.recommended_fix: Guard: expectf(interval > SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS + 1) at leg start.
